provenance.sectionHeading: ## Runners-up, measured ones first (all verified, all cut by the 15-cap)
provenance.scopeNote: Scope note:reviewed the working tree at `driver-run-scheduler` (post-driver scheduler + pristine exporter and dispatcher). Excluded `reference/` — those files are md5-identical across all three task dirs and are copies of unrelated pi-hydra project docs, not code under review.
provenance.countNote: 13 verbatim bullets; the artifact README's '~14' was an approximation. Several bullets bundle 2-3 distinct defects and will split under RULING 2 individuation when pooled.

runnersUp.verbatim: `exporter.js:15` N+1: 20,000 orders for one customer = **20,005 queries, 26.2s**; correct is 6. 500 orders / 5 customers = 506.
`db.js:13` with `since`: per-page cost is O(total rows), not O(page size) — a 100k-row export at page size 10k **examines 1,100,000 rows** across 11 full table scans. Quadratic in table size.

`format.js:12`: **2050 of the first 300,000 ms values** render nonsense — `119999` → `"1m60s"`, `59950` → `"60.0s"`, `3599999` → `"59m60s"`. No hour carry (`86400000` → `"1440m00s"`); `NaN`/`undefined` → `"NaNmNaNs"`.
`dispatchAll` serializes retry backoff across independent charges: 10 failing charges = 14,111ms; concurrent is bounded by 1400ms.
`exporter.js:16` `row.amount.toFixed(2)` aborts the entire export on a null or string amount (string DECIMAL is the pg/mysql2 default).
`exporter.js:23` `exportFilename` path traversal (`orders-../../etc/passwd-....csv`) and CRLF header injection; UTC date stamps the wrong day near midnight.
`scheduler.js:61` `complete(store,id,null)` retires a never-claimed job (`null !== null` is false); a stale owner can also complete a job a sweep already returned to pending.
`db.js:20` `getCustomer` fabricates `{name:"unknown",tier:"none"}`, so a broken foreign key ships as plausible data.

`http.js:6` `createClient` holds the caller's array by reference and `shift()` destroys it; once drained, `post` returns a synthetic `200 OK`, so an under-scripted test passes. `client.sent` stores bodies by reference, so the audit record can be rewritten after the fact.
`redact.test.js:10` passes for an identity function, and it is the only test on `redactLine` — the function the dispatcher actually calls.
`exporter.js:19`: LF not CRLF, no trailing newline, no BOM (a customer named `Müller` mojibakes in Excel); a `Date` in `createdAt` stringifies with the machine's locale and timezone.
`renewLease`/`sweepExpired`/`putJob`/`countOrders`/`exportFilename` have zero call sites — the lease is never renewed by any shipped path, so any handler running past 30s becomes sweepable mid-run.

`claimNext` sorts the whole backlog per call (50k jobs = 7.48ms and 714k comparisons per tick; a min-scan is 0.29ms); `logSummary` adds 3 full map scans per tick including idle ones, and logs one line per idle poll (36k lines/hour at 100ms).
